title: FactoryPredictionV1
description: AI prediction event. Topic: factory.predictions.v1, key: equipmentId. Produced exclusively by prediction-service. NON-AUTHORITATIVE: this event is a recommendation only and confers no control authority (ADR-0002). v0.3 adds deploymentStage (GAP-070), featureSchemaVersion (GAP-073), and validSampleRatio (DEC-008).

predictedAtUtc.description: When inference completed. MUST be strictly increasing per equipmentId (DEC-003) - Control Service supersession ordering depends on this guarantee.

runId.description: MLflow run ID. Links prediction to training run (FR-040, AC-008).

deploymentStage.description: REQUIRED by ADR-0010. Without it, shadow/canary output is indistinguishable from production at the decision point (GAP-070). Safety Supervisor rejects any stage not authorized for this equipment with MODEL_STAGE_UNAUTHORIZED.

featureSchemaVersion.description: Detects training-serving skew at decision time (GAP-073). Supervisor rejects on mismatch with the authorized model record.

validSampleRatio.description: Per-channel valid-sample ratio (DEC-008). Nulls are excluded from aggregates, never zero-filled. A prediction is NOT produced at all when any safety-required channel is below 0.8.

oodScore.description: Higher is more out-of-distribution. Compared against the authorized model record's oodThreshold. OOD is a HARD REJECT (DEC-005).

recommendedOperationRatePct.description: The AI's proposed setpoint. NON-BINDING. Null means the model declines to recommend, which is a valid output and is not an error.

causationId.description: The featureWindow.windowId this prediction derives from. Continues the causation chain from telemetry.
